projects.title: PHC Mobile: Attendance & HR System
projects.description: Built an internal HR mobile app covering attendance, leave requests, and employee records. Face recognition handles check-in validation; geolocation logs entry and exit.
projects.challenge: Face recognition doesn't behave the same across every device and lighting condition — consistent results were harder to get than expected.
projects.solution: Built a photo comparison flow backed by a Python service and wired it into the mobile app.

projects.title: PHC Mobile: Gamification Module
projects.description: Added a gamification module to the PHC app — quiz challenges, a leaderboard, and performance work to keep scrolling smooth on large datasets. Capped the image cache to prevent storage from growing out of control. Resized images at load time to match UI dimensions and reduce memory pressure.
projects.challenge: Rendering hundreds of leaderboard entries with images without the UI becoming unusable.
projects.solution: Applied caching and image optimization to bring down memory usage and keep the list scrollable.

technicalOptimizations.title: Image Caching
technicalOptimizations.description: Implemented a cache mechanism to limit stored images and prevent excessive storage usage.

technicalOptimizations.title: Optimized Image Loading
technicalOptimizations.description: Resized images during loading to match UI needs and reduce memory consumption.

technicalOptimizations.title: Efficient List Rendering
technicalOptimizations.description: Adjusted rendering strategy to keep scrolling smooth when displaying large datasets.

projects.title: PeriplusApps Mobile
projects.description: Worked on PeriplusApps, a mobile e-commerce app tied to periplus.com. Focused on performance tuning, fixing visual inconsistencies across devices, and getting features to behave reliably across different modules. Cut duplicate API calls and corrected endpoints that were pointing to the wrong places. Fixed layouts to behave consistently across phone and tablet screen sizes. Tracked down and fixed a set of bugs: bad request mappings, UI overflow, and state that wasn't being reset properly.
projects.challenge: Keeping UI behavior consistent and performance stable across phones and tablets while wiring up multiple features and APIs.
projects.solution: Trimmed redundant API calls, fixed data mapping bugs, and tightened up layout behavior across modules.

technicalOptimizations.title: API Optimization
technicalOptimizations.description: Removed redundant API calls and fixed incorrect endpoint usage to improve efficiency.

technicalOptimizations.title: Responsive UI Improvements
technicalOptimizations.description: Adjusted layouts and components to ensure consistency across mobile and tablet devices.

technicalOptimizations.title: Bug Fixing & Data Mapping
technicalOptimizations.description: Resolved multiple issues including incorrect request mapping, UI overflow, and inconsistent state handling.

projects.title: Mobile POS (Point of Sale) Application
projects.description: Built a mobile POS app for cashier operations — transaction processing, product handling, and receipt printing. Simpler and easier to maintain than the desktop system it replaced.
projects.challenge: Supporting cashier workflows on mobile while managing pricing rules, hardware, and replacing a desktop POS setup.
projects.solution: Built a mobile POS with a simple, responsive UI, lean API calls, and basic printer and scanner support.

projects.title: Book Search & Recommendation System
projects.description: Built a book search and recommendation feature for a large product catalog, with keyword search, suggestions, and basic recommendation logic.
projects.challenge: Search was slow and results weren't relevant enough for the catalog size.
projects.solution: Reworked the OpenSearch query logic, keyword handling, and indexing. Added more search capabilities to surface better results.

projects.title: NADIA – Network Terminal Equipment Management
projects.description: Worked on an internal Telkom Indonesia system for managing returned NTE assets like customer routers. Untangled confusing workflows, fixed bugs in older features, and tidied up the code structure.
projects.challenge: A legacy system where nobody fully understood the business rules anymore — bugs were frequent and asset retrieval logic was unclear.
projects.solution: Mapped out the real workflows with stakeholders and documented them. Refactored using NestJS and Next.js, enforced code quality via SonarQube, and added scheduled jobs for recurring processes (using Airflow).
features: NTE asset retrieval and return tracking
responsibilities: Translated business requirements into technical workflows
Collaborated with stakeholders to clarify processes
Implemented scheduled jobs using Apache Airflow
impact: Made business workflows easier to understand
Helped teams follow clearer asset retrieval processes

projects.title: PEFITA – Package Management System
projects.description: Improved the map visualization in an internal package management tool used to configure and price product bundles.
projects.challenge: Improving the map feature without disrupting the rest of the system.
projects.solution: Extended the map using Google Maps, added Street View, and integrated the changes into the existing frontend and backend without breaking other parts.

projects.title: SCONE – Order Management System
projects.description: Helped migrate the legacy order management UI at Telkom Indonesia to Next.js and worked on connecting the order flow to downstream systems.
projects.challenge: Replacing a legacy UI with Next.js while matching the team's design standards and keeping order statuses in sync across systems.
projects.solution: Rebuilt the relevant screens from the existing design specs and implemented integration flows to keep order state consistent.
features: UI migration from Zend Framework to Next.js
Updated interface based on existing design standards

projects.title: DMS – Document Management System
projects.description: Built a document landing page with CRUD support for an internal Telkom Indonesia document system, used for uploads and accessed by other internal tools.
projects.challenge: File uploads and storage needed careful handling — especially around deletion, where errors in object storage aren't easily reversible.
projects.solution: Worked with the team to define the document flow. Stored files via MinIO and managed state transitions without using direct deletion.

projects.title: PPT – Master Data Management
projects.description: Migrated a Master Data Management frontend from PHP to Next.js, fixing usability issues and aligning it with the team's existing UI patterns.
projects.challenge: Tight deadline, and most requirements came through system analysts rather than directly from the business.
projects.solution: Worked from the provided specs, flagged ambiguities early, and stayed in regular contact with the analysts. Delivered on time.
features: UI migration from PHP to Next.js
Updated interface based on existing standards

projects.title: PABOI (Indonesia Orthopedic Association) Web Application
projects.description: Contributed to the PABOI web app during a 4-month internship, taking on both backend and frontend work across different parts of the product.
projects.challenge: Ramping up on a real team workflow and contributing to a production system without prior professional experience.
projects.solution: Fixed bugs and shipped small features on both frontend and backend. Followed team processes and worked alongside QA and product.
features: Bug fixing on backend and frontend

projects.title: JTK Berbagi – Donation Management Platform
projects.description: Built a donation management platform for POLBAN's Computer Engineering Department — covers campaign setup, transaction tracking, and distribution logging.
projects.challenge: Building a donation system from scratch with requirements that changed as the project moved forward.
projects.solution: Gathered requirements, defined the workflows, built the core features, and tested until it matched how donations actually needed to work.

projects.title: Sinbada
projects.description: Built a web-based inventory system in a university team project to manage asset and stock data.
projects.challenge: Worked in a team environment while learning to use multiple technologies and understand how frontend and backend systems interact.
projects.solution: Contributed to both frontend and backend development and followed team workflows to complete assigned tasks.

projects.title: Siinvent
projects.description: Earlier university team project — a basic web inventory system for tracking stock and inventory records.
projects.challenge: First time working with a shared codebase and figuring out how to contribute without causing conflicts.
projects.solution: Built features alongside teammates, used version control throughout, and picked up the basic development workflow as the project went on.
